story.text: A Fish-Footman brings the Duchess an {INVITATION} from the Queen to play {CROQUET}. Inside, the kitchen is full of smoke and {PEPPER}. The Duchess nurses a howling baby, the {COOK} flings saucepans and plates, and everyone {SNEEZES} except the cook and a large cat, {GRINNING} from ear to ear.
story.caption: The Duchess, the cook and the baby
story.credit: John Tenniel, coloured for The Nursery “Alice”, 1890
